gss_enabled.description: Enable Grid Security Service (GSS) configuration block (required for authenticated job submission).

gss_instances.description: List of GSS service instances. Each instance defines how security authentication/authorization is performed for GRAM.

name.description: Name/identifier of the GSS service instance.

pbs_job_manager_executable.description: Path to the PBS job manager executable (or wrapper script used by GRAM).

pbs_job_manager_jobtype.description: Type of job manager (must be 'pbs' for PBS support).

pbs_job_manager_account.description: Account string to pass to PBS (e.g., for accounting or qos). Optional.

pbs_job_manager_queue.description: Default PBS queue for submitted jobs.

pbs_job_manager_project.description: Project name/identifier for PBS job submission. Optional.

pbs_job_manager_walltime.description: Default walltime limit (e.g., '01:00:00') for submitted jobs. Optional.

pbs_job_manager_memory.description: Default memory limit (e.g., '2048M') for submitted jobs. Optional.

pbs_job_manager_processes.description: Total number of processes requested per job. Optional.

pbs_job_manager_processor_count.description: Number of processors (CPUs) requested per job. Optional.

pbs_job_manager_memory_per_node.description: Memory requested per compute node (e.g., '8G'). Optional.

pbs_job_manager_processes_per_node.description: Number of processes (e.g., MPI ranks) per compute node. Optional.

pbs_job_manager_hosts_file.description: Path to hosts file (e.g., /tmp/machinesfile) for MPI job launch. Optional.

pbs_job_manager_environment.description: List of environment variables to set for submitted PBS jobs.

gridftp_enabled.description: Enable GridFTP server support for data staging (recommended for job input/output transfer).

gridftp_servers.description: List of GridFTP server instances for data transfers (e.g., staging input files).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the GridFTP server.

port.description: Port number on which GridFTP server listens.

transfer_mode.description: Transfer mode: 'passive' or 'active'. Passive is recommended for firewalled clients.

certificate.description: Path to the GridFTP server certificate file.

key.description: Path to the GridFTP server private key file.

ca_certificate.description: Path to a specific CA certificate (for single-CA scenarios). Optional.

trusted_ca_certs_dir.description: Directory containing trusted CA certificates (used for client authentication).
